class.name: VirtualButtonAnimated
class.brief_description: A virtual button with progress visualization support.
class.description: [VirtualButtonAnimated] extends [VirtualButton] by adding a progress bar overlay. This is useful for representing cooldowns, charging states, or any timed interaction visually on the button itself.

members.member: The direction in which the progress bar fills.
If [code]true[/code], the progress bar overlay will be drawn.
The current progress value, from 0.0 to 1.0.

constants.constant: The progress bar fills from left to right.
The progress bar fills from right to left.
The progress bar fills from top to bottom.
The progress bar fills from bottom to top.

theme_items.theme_item: The color used to draw the progress bar if [code]progress_style[/code] is not defined.
The [StyleBox] used to draw the progress bar overlay.
